# The writer states a number that no cited quote holds. The citation check, a program gate, stops the section with the status cites-failed.
# The desk does not reach the review and writes nothing to the wiki.
[!exec:jq] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

rdinit
rdfakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env RESEARCH_DESK_DIR=$WORK/rd
env RESEARCH_HOME=$WORK/store
env SEARCH_API=http://search.test
env WIKI_API=http://wiki.test
env RESEARCH_HEADER_FILE=$WORK/home/.research/credential.header
# Without the citation check the run would reach the review. A short deadline makes that a fast failure of this script, not a long wait.
env REVIEW_TIMEOUT=2s

exec beehavereal item add research-desk cold-cost --title 'Cold and cost' --body-file body.txt
! exec beehavereal run cold-cost research-desk --workflow rd/workflow.star
stderr 'fails the citation check'
stderr 'states the number 50, which is not in a cited quote'

grep 'cites-failed' store/cold-cost/s1.1/status
! exists wiki.log
! exists store/cold-cost/report.md

-- body.txt --
How does the cold change the output of a unit, and what does it cost?
-- bad-prose --

Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
